title: MCPAgentBench: A Real-world Task Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agent MCP Tool Use
abstract: arXiv:2512.24565v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly serving as autonomous agents, and their utilization of external tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) is considered a future trend. Current MCP evaluation sets suffer from issues such as reliance on external MCP services and a lack of difficulty awareness. To address these limitations, we propose MCPAgentBench, a benchmark based on real-world MCP definitions designed to evaluate the tool-use capabilities of agents. We construct a dataset containing authentic tasks and simulated MCP tools. The evaluation employs a dynamic sandbox environment that presents agents with candidate tool lists containing distractors, thereby testing their tool selection and discrimination abilities. Furthermore, we introduce comprehensive metrics to measure both task completion rates and execution efficiency. translated_title: MCPAgentBench：用于评估LLM智能体MCP工具使用的真实世界任务基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.24565v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用作自主智能体，其通过模型上下文协议（MCP）使用外部工具被视为未来趋势。当前的MCP评估集存在依赖外部MCP服务以及缺乏难度意识等问题。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了MCPAgentBench，这是一个基于真实世界MCP定义设计的基准，旨在评估智能体的工具使用能力。我们构建了一个包含真实任务和模拟MCP工具的数据集。评估采用动态沙盒环境，向智能体呈现包含干扰项的候选工具列表，从而测试其工具选择和辨别能力。此外，我们引入了全面的指标来衡量任务完成率和执行效率。在最先进的大语言模型上进行的实验揭示了在处理方面的显著性能差异
tldr: 提出MCPAgentBench，一个基于真实任务和模拟MCP工具、采用含干扰项的动态沙盒环境的基准，用于评估大语言模型智能体的工具选择与使用能力，并通过任务完成率和执行效率等指标揭示了模型间的显著性能差异
en_tdlr: Proposes MCPAgentBench, a benchmark based on real-world tasks and simulated MCP tools with a dynamic sandbox environment containing distractor tools, to evaluate LLM agents' tool selection and usage capabilities, revealing significant performance differences across models through metrics measuring both task completion rates and execution efficiency
